verdict.rationale: Kong's Insomnia product explicitly supports importing/exporting collections in multiple portable formats (Insomnia JSON/YAML, Postman v2.0/2.1, HAR, OpenAPI, Swagger, WSDL, cURL) via UI or CLI (inso export spec), enabling movement between tools like Postman. Some community friction exists around Insomnia requiring accounts, but this doesn't contradict the import/export capability itself. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of round-trip fidelity, evidence of export to non-OpenAPI/Postman targets.
